scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:web-api: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/estudai-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck
scripts.build:web-api: pnpm run typecheck:web-api && pnpm --filter @workspace/estudai-web run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
